mapper.insert: INSERT INTO boarding_records ( pet_id, check_in_date, expected_day, price_per_day, base_fee, status, notes, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{petId}, #{checkInDate}, #{expectedReturn}, #{pricePerDay}, #{baseFee}, 'BOARDING', #{notes}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT b.*, p.name AS pet_name, o.name AS owner_name FROM boarding_records b JOIN pets p ON b.pet_id = p.id JOIN owners o ON p.owner_id = o.id ORDER BY b.id DESC

SELECT b.*, p.name AS pet_name, o.name AS owner_name, re.note, re.created_at FROM boarding_records b JOIN pets p ON b.pet_id = p.id JOIN owners o ON p.owner_id = o.id JOIN care_notes re ON b.id = re.boarding_record_id WHERE b.id = #{id}

SELECT b.*, p.name AS pet_name, o.full_name AS owner_name FROM boarding_records b JOIN pets p ON b.pet_id = p.id JOIN owners o ON p.owner_id = o.id WHERE b.status = 'BOARDING' ORDER BY b.check_in_date DESC
SELECT b.*, p.name AS pet_name, o.name AS owner_name FROM boarding_records b JOIN pets p ON b.pet_id = p.id JOIN owners o ON p.owner_id = o.id WHERE p.id = #{petId} ORDER BY b.check_in_date DESC
SELECT b.*, p.name AS pet_name, o.name AS owner_name FROM boarding_records b JOIN pets p ON b.pet_id = p.id JOIN owners o ON p.owner_id = o.id WHERE o.id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY b.check_in_date DESC

SELECT b.*, p.name AS pet_name, o.name AS owner_name FROM boarding_records b JOIN pets p ON b.pet_id = p.id JOIN owners o ON p.owner_id = o.id WHERE b.check_in_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY b.check_in_date DESC

SELECT b.*, p.name AS pet_name, o.name AS owner_name FROM boarding_records b JOIN pets p ON b.pet_id = p.id JOIN owners o ON p.owner_id = o.id JOIN users u ON o.id = u.owner_id WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND b.status = 'BOARDING'

SELECT b.*, p.name AS pet_name, o.name AS owner_name FROM boarding_records b JOIN pets p ON b.pet_id = p.id JOIN owners o ON p.owner_id = o.id JOIN users u ON o.id = u.owner_id WHERE u.id = #{userId} ORDER BY b.check_in_date DESC
